description: A portable MCP catalog: synca mcp export writes it, synca mcp import installs it. Per-server objects use the same shape agent configs do. env and header values are verbatim — keep catalogs private.

version.description: Catalog format version. 1 is the only one so far.

type.description: Transport: stdio, http or sse. Inferred from the url and command when absent.

command.description: stdio only: the executable, or a full argv array.

args.description: stdio only: arguments after the executable.

url.description: http and sse only: the server URL.

enabled.description: false marks a server the agents should not load.

origin.description: Registry provenance carried from the mcp lock file, so mcp update keeps working after a re-import.
